name: Z2Labs EMS
description: EM simulation pre-processor for KiCad boards, using the Z2 EMS engine (an openEMS fork with a CUDA engine). Ports, ground, stackup presets, mesh preview, simulation, field overlays.

actions.name: Z2Labs EMS
actions.description: Ports (+ pad and ground reference), stackup, mesh and simulation of this board

actions.name: Z2Labs EMS: fab stackup
actions.description: Pick a manufacturer stackup preset (JLCPCB, ...) and write it into this board

actions.name: Z2Labs EMS: simulate
actions.description: Open the Z2Labs EMS window to define ports and run the simulation

actions.name: Z2Labs EMS: mesh preview
actions.description: Draw the FDTD mesh the engine would use on a user layer

actions.name: Z2Labs EMS: field overlay
actions.description: Overlay the current-density maps of the last run on user layers

actions.name: Z2Labs EMS: engine
actions.description: Install, update or locate the Z2 EMS engine (download from github.com/z2labs/z2ems)
